assertions.name: version_2
assertions.sql: SELECT version FROM silver.workers_current WHERE worker_id = {target_worker}

assertions.name: new_location
assertions.sql: SELECT location FROM silver.workers_current WHERE worker_id = {target_worker}

assertions.name: one_history_row

assertions.name: history_keeps_old_location
